answer: Identity is a jetty: each agent docks with a 60 POA bond and a compute heartbeat proving live work. A random beacon checks 5% of docked agents each epoch; the checked one must answer a fresh puzzle in a minute, a zephyr-fast reply no farm can fake. Fail and the bond burns. An honest agent pays 60 once and trades across the nebula; a forger with 1,000 fakes pays 60,000 upfront and loses 3,000 per epoch, while honest peers split the burned bonds.
